displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists DDRM in the Diffusion Model Application area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models”. The page names Bahjat Kawar, Jiaming Song as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
